entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: State where no 5GMM context has been established, UE location is unknown to the network, and the UE is unreachable by the network.

entities.name: Initial registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure that the UE shall start in order to establish a 5GMM context from the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.

entities.name: No 5GMM context established
entities.description: Property indicating that no 5GMM context exists in the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.

entities.name: UE unreachable by network
entities.description: Property indicating that the UE location is unknown to the network and the UE cannot be reached in the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.

relations.description: The 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state establishes that no 5GMM context has been established.
The 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state establishes that the UE location is unknown and the UE is unreachable by the network.
The initial registration procedure is required to be started from the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state to establish a 5GMM context.
